name: Proto-Mongolic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Mongolic is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Mongolic family; Middle Mongol is its earliest attested stage. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.
